title: The Death and Burial of Sarah
description: Sarah dies at the age of 127 in Hebron. Abraham negotiates with Ephron the Hittite and buys the Cave of Makpelah for 400 shekels of silver as a burial site – his first property in Canaan.

versions.title: The Death and Burial of Sarah
versions.description: Abraham mourns Sarah and buys the Cave of Makpelah in Hebron as her burial place, which becomes the first property in the promised land.
